capabilities.description: Maintains the register of every machine in the fleet with type, size class, identifiers, registration, insurance and service status. Covers 20 excavators/shovels (5 each at 3, 5, 8 and 10 tons), 10 road sweepers, 20 bobcats, 5 forklifts, 20 plate compactors, 5 roller compactors and 5 power generator
requirements: 20 excavator / shovel , 3 Tons 5 Ton and 8 tons 10 tons 5 each , 10 road sweepers , 20 bobcats , 5 forklifts , 20 plate compactors , 5 roller compactors , 5 power genarators

capabilities.description: Manages hire agreements from quote to on-hire and off-hire, tracking which machine is with which customer, on what terms, and when it returns. Supports overdue-hire reminders when a machine is not returned by the agreed date.
Computes machine availability from the hire book and detects double-booking clashes before an agreement is confirmed.
requirements: machine availability and double-booking clash detection

capabilities.description: Issues invoices from the platform itself in AUD including 10% GST, with production-ready billing, payment tracking and chasing of unpaid/overdue invoices.
requirements: invoicing issued by the platform itself in AUD including GST at 10% with chasing of unpaid/overdue invoices

capabilities.description: Tracks service-due intervals, registration expiry and insurance expiry per machine and raises alerts to managers ahead of time.
Single-role manager workbench: authenticated manager logins only, with dashboards over the fleet book, invoices and alerts. No driver logins and no customer self-serve portal.
Audit capability (reused from the block store)
Construction capability (reused from the block store)
Insurance capability (reused from the block store)
Voice capability (reused from the block store)
